ai_insights.analysis: The Packers' defense, anchored by their front three (Karl Brooks, Chris McClellan, Devonte Wyatt) and secondary (Keisean Nixon, Xavier McKinney), should dominate the Panthers' offense. Without Jaelan Phillips, Carolina's pass rush is weakened, allowing Jordan Love to operate comfortably. The Packers' offensive line, despite missing Sean Rhyan and Travis Glover, should protect Love adequately, while their running game (Josh Jacobs) could exploit Carolina's injury-depleted defensive line. The Panthers' offense, led by Bryce Young, may struggle without Damien Lewis and Jaelan Phillips, but explosive plays from Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker could keep the game competitive. The Packers' special teams (Daniel Whelan) should outperform Carolina's (Sam Martin), securing field position. Final score projection: Green Bay Packers 27, Carolina Panthers 20.
